title: Finite replacement stages and their next boundary
statement: For a scheme X and a simplicial etale X-scheme K, a replacement stage through degree n consists of a truncated finite split etale hypercover U [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover] and a natural transformation from U to the n-truncation of K. Restriction to m at most n retains the objects, operators, nondegenerate summands, matching witnesses and natural transformation in degrees at most m. Restriction is the identity at n and is transitive. Boundary data for U consist of an etale X-scheme M, projections to every lower simplex mapping to [n+1], their naturality equations, and the matching universal property among all schemes over X. The boundary data also include compactness and quasi-separatedness of M.
